work_title: Upgrade iOS runtime to MobiVM 3.0.0 and Ergo AppKit 6.0.1 (Scala 2.12) (#189)
description: Upgraded the iOS runtime from RoboVM 2.3.19 (Scala 2.11) to MobiVM 3.0.0 and Ergo AppKit 6.0.1 (Scala 2.12.21 / sigma-state 6.0.6), removed obsolete JRE7 java.time/java.util.function stubs, added isolated bootCompat shims for java.lang.ClassValue and scala.collection.immutable.VM on MobiVM libcore, and verified end-to-end across Ubuntu (JVM/Android/Desktop) and macOS MobiVM AOT builds (arm64 device, arm64-simulator, and native runtime smoke test).
